privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site is a personal home for Dalibor Plečić's writing, and it collects as little information as possible. This page explains what the contact form collects and how those details are handled.

collect.title: What the form collects
collect.body: When you use the contact form, you share your name, your email address, and your message. Nothing else is collected, and the rest of the site works without giving any details.

handle.title: How your message is handled
handle.body: Messages are delivered by Formspree, a form-handling service, which forwards them to Dalibor's inbox. Your details are used only to read and reply to your message. They are not sold, rented, or shared for marketing.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.body: Your message is kept only as long as needed to correspond with you, then deleted.

cookies.title: Tracking and cookies
cookies.body: This site does not use analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies. Your language choice is carried in the web address, not stored on your device.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can ask to see a copy of what you sent, or ask for it to be deleted, by getting in touch at the email on the contact page.

changes.title: Changes to this page
changes.body: If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted here.
